title: Kojo | Integrations

## Software Integrations

### Connect to your source of truth

Kojo speaks to your accounting system as you source quotes and availability, purchase materials, track deliveries, manage warehouse inventory, automate 3-way invoice matching and pay invoices.

### Visibility into material spend

Sync material orders and costs directly to your accounting or project management system without any additional data entry, allowing you to track material spend and progress throughout the job.
